bio.text: Codi Galloway represents Idaho Senate District 15; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a first Senate term and one earlier House term (2020-2022), and a business owner occupation.
The legislature biography says Galloway was raised in Boise, attended Centennial High School, and holds a B.S. in education from BYU and an M.B.A. from Northwest Nazarene University.
The biography lists work as a public school teacher, CTE school owner and small business owner.
